title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: Fee Lines Covered by a Service Level Credit
content:
The fee lines a service level credit for the latest census month covers follow how the month was billed under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement:

- where the month's invoice carries a per-worker fee line under the employer-paid fee model, the credit base adds that line's amount less any billing-error credit booked against it;
- where it carries sponsored instant fee or sponsored next-business-day fee lines and no per-worker fee line, the credit base adds those lines' amounts less any billing-error credit booked against them;
- otherwise no fee line is added.

| Lines on the invoice for the claimed month | Added to the credit base |
|---|---|
| a per-worker fee line | that line's amount less any billing-error credit against it |
| sponsored instant or next-business-day fee lines, no per-worker fee line | those lines' amounts less any billing-error credits against them |
| neither | nothing |

**When the credit is fixed.** A service level credit for a month is not fixed until the per-worker fee line billed for that month carries the billing-error credit owed on it for any amount billed above the per-worker fee. Put in terms of the records: while the per-worker fee line billed for the claimed month shows an amount billed above the per-worker fee and does not yet carry the billing-error credit owed on it, the service level credit for that month is not fixed.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A claimed month whose invoice carries a per-worker fee line of 2910.00 against which a billing-error credit of 85.00 is booked adds 2825.00 to the credit base. A month billed with a sponsored instant fee line of 412.00 and a sponsored next-business-day fee line of 96.00, with no credits against them, adds 508.00.
